classification.difficultyReason: Select the taught ambient-temperature model, determine its constants, convert minutes to seconds and solve for a target temperature using logarithms.

content.prompt: A piece of meat, initially at $14^\circ\mathrm{C}$, is placed in a freezer whose temperature is a constant $-10^\circ\mathrm{C}$. After 25 seconds the temperature of the meat is $11^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Find:

children.label: a
children.prompt: the meat's temperature after 5 minutes, to 1 decimal place

answer.worked:
Use $T=-10+Ae^{kt}$, with $t$ measured in seconds. At $t=0$:
$$\begin{aligned}14&=-10+A\\A&=24\end{aligned}$$
At $t=25$:
$$\begin{aligned}11&=-10+24e^{25k}\\21&=24e^{25k}\\e^{25k}&=\frac78\\k&=\frac{1}{25}\ln\left(\frac78\right)\end{aligned}$$
Thus $T(t)=-10+24e^{kt}$. Since 5 minutes is 300 seconds:
$$\begin{aligned}T(300)&=-10+24e^{300k}\\&=-10+24\left(\frac78\right)^{12}\\&\approx-5.2^\circ\mathrm{C}\end{aligned}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: when the temperature will reach $-8^\circ\mathrm{C}$, to the nearest minute.

answer.worked:
Using $T=-10+24e^{kt}$ with $k=\frac{1}{25}\ln\left(\frac78\right)$ and $t$ in seconds:
$$\begin{aligned}-8&=-10+24e^{kt}\\2&=24e^{kt}\\e^{kt}&=\frac{1}{12}\\kt&=\ln\left(\frac{1}{12}\right)\\t&=\frac{\ln(1/12)}{k}\\&\approx465.23\text{ seconds}\end{aligned}$$
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Time in minutes}&=\frac{\ln(1/12)}{60k}\\&\approx7.75\text{ minutes}\end{aligned}$$
The temperature reaches $-8^\circ\mathrm{C}$ after approximately 8 minutes, to the nearest minute.
